title: List every employee with a department
prompt: Return first_name and department for every employee, sorted by first_name. department is the name of the employee's department, or the text No department when the employee has none. The starter leaves one employee out.
hints: Count the starter's rows. How many employees are there?
An inner join drops an employee whose department_id matches nothing.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Keeps every department instead of every employee.
Keeps the employee but leaves the department as NULL.

feedback: Find Alex in your result. The row must be there, and its department must read No department.
